concerns.text: Target token bins stated as '100, 200, 300, and 400 tokens' but idea/methodology sketch specifies '50, 100, 200, 300, 400 tokens' (5 variants). Spec drops the 50-token minimal variant.

FR-017 mandates n=10 samples per triplet, but US-1 Acceptance Scenario 1 tests only 'first 10 problems with 5 distinct prompt elaboration levels' without explicitly confirming 10 samples per triplet are generated in the test.

Assumption states 'The use of pass@1 introduces stochastic variance...' but this is methodological guidance, not an assumption about external conditions. Should be moved to a 'Methodological Notes' section or integrated into the ANOVA methodology description (FR-006).

Semantic equivalence check uses 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L-v2' but idea/methodology sketch specifies 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2' (different model variant). Spec drifts the validation tool.

SC-010 states 'at least 100 problems (or the full dataset when feasible)' but the idea's methodology sketch says 'full set (N=164) unless runtime constraints force a fallback to a stratified random sample of 100 problems.' Spec softens the commitment to 100 as a floor.
